setup_mae_image_classification_task: setup a MaeImageClassificationTask from a MaeImageClassificationConfig for MAE image classification fine-tuning
load_mae_finetuning_dataset: load a MaeFinetuningImageDataset for a given split like train or test with configurable input size
build_mae_model_from_checkpoint: build an MAE model from a model config and optionally load pretrained model args from a checkpoint
reduce_metrics_for_accuracy: reduce logging outputs to compute and log accuracy as a derived metric from correct predictions
review_mae_image_classification_config: review the MaeImageClassificationConfig dataclass fields including data path, input size, local cache path, and rebuild batches
